name: The majority voted in favour of a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2018-09-10.35.1) introduced by Greens Senator [Richard Di Natalie](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/victoria/richard_di_natale) (Vic), which means it succeeded. This motion will change the [second reading motion](https://www.peo.gov.au/learning/fact-sheets/making-a-law.html), which is "*that the bills be read for a second time*" or, in other words, "*that the majority agree with the main idea of the bills*". ### Motion text > *At the end of the motion, add:* > *", but the Senate calls on the government, as a matter of urgency, to refer to the Productivity Commission the matter of whether the private health insurance rebate promotes the economically efficient operation of the health system."*
